task: Before planning, read kernel_src/EXPERIMENT_CONTEXT.md completely and treat it as mandatory campaign memory. Use the full 32-direction budget unless correctness or infrastructure blocks progress. This is a standalone FlyDSL gfx1201 campaign seeded by the current M=1..64 raw-weight kernel plus the live vLLM Triton fallback for broader M. Expand the implementation with multiple optimized FlyDSL prefill kernel variants and compact coarse routing over M/tile-count, N-grid, and K-block regimes; do not optimize Triton and do not use exact captured-M or exact (M,N,K) tables. Preserve the existing FlyDSL M=1..64 routes and the exact FP32-per-K128 scaled-partial accumulation, BF16 output, arbitrary padded B row stride, fresh outputs, current-input behavior, graph safety, and one device dispatch. No AITER, CK, CDNA MFMA, gfx1250-only features, weight preshuffle, persistent weight copies, activation/output memoization, extra reduction dispatches, or changes outside kernel_src. The primary score is the counted ratio of sums over 35 captured Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 prefill cases. All decode, existing-route, boundary, cross-section, and non-Qwen portability cases are zero-weight hard gates and must remain at least 0.98x. Require five-draw live parity at rtol=0.02 and atol=0.0625 plus output independence. Bank only reproducible gains of at least 0.5%, require every banked patch to add or improve a genuinely general FlyDSL route bucket with source/profile engagement proof, and target at least 1.01x final weighted speedup with gains distributed across the scored families. Start with M=65..128, then M=129..256, M=257..512, and M=513..1024; explore BM/BN geometry, waves per workgroup, raw-B reuse, LDS layouts, split signal/wait scheduling via gfx12_sync, prefetch distance, WMMA scheduling, scale-load overlap, K-loop policy, epilogue layout, and WGP grid fill. Before final promotion run three cache-flushed reversed-order paired passes, CUDA-graph replay, and report per-family FlyDSL coverage plus ISA VGPR/SGPR/LDS/workgroup and ATT hotspot evidence.

op_spec.implementation: standalone FlyDSL gfx120x WMMA raw-weight block-scaled FP8 GEMM router
op_spec.layout_contract: A[M,K] and A_scale[M,K/128] are contiguous. B is logical [N,K] with stride(1)=1 and arbitrary padded stride(0). B_scale[N/128,K/128] is contiguous.
op_spec.math_contract: For each K128 block, complete the FP8 dot in FP32, multiply its independent FP32 A/B scales, accumulate scaled blocks in FP32, and cast once to BF16.
op_spec.routing_contract: Use a small explainable family of FlyDSL routes based on M/tile count, N-grid, and K-block regimes. Never route by exact captured shape or model identity.
